notes: W2-D shots. The kings face upstream (NNE, heading 15°), so the film framing — low on the water, looking up at their faces and raised palms, backlit by the afternoon sun — is taken from UPSTREAM looking downstream: argonath-lowpass (8.5 km NNE on the Anduin, 1.5 above the water). w2d-* are close inspections of the GLB kings (heads, the raised hand).
